problem_summary: 14 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Hoodi between May 2019 and July 2022, spanning 4 calendar year(s). 57% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened). 2 complaint(s) were re-opened after initially being resolved.

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

agency_attribution_note: 14 of 14 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.53). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, unresolved_rate=0.57, complaint_volume=0.47.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Hoodi' not found in name crosswalk (one of the 15 unmatched wards). No enrichment applied.
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Hoodi for the period 2019–2022.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
Investigate the 2 re-opened complaint(s) to determine whether patchwork repairs were applied and failed.
